title: Clinical SOAP Note Writer

title: Differential Diagnosis Assistant

title: Patient Education Explainer

title: Prior Authorization Letter Writer

title: Hospital Discharge Summary Generator

title: High-Converting Ad Copy Generator

title: Code Review Assistant

title: Unit Test Generator

title: Bug Root Cause Explainer

title: API Documentation Writer

title: SQL Query Optimizer

title: Lesson Plan Generator

title: Rubric Builder

title: Student Feedback Writer

title: Quiz & Assessment Question Generator

title: Socratic Tutor

title: Neighborhood Profile Writer
